text_block_list.text:
Though Haru Urara couldn't secure the win, 
she seemed thoroughly satisfied just 
enjoying the race.

Determined to run in more and more races 
and rack up experience, Haru Urara and her 
Trainer raised their fists in unison.

Before heading home, Haru Urara is 
congratulated on her debut by the local 
shopping district folks who came out to 
cheer for her.

To live up to the expectations of the 
shopping district folks who loved her, 
Haru Urara vowed to become even stronger.
